description: Make a payment link and a plain text pay button for it. type paypalme builds https://paypal.me/<name> with an optional amount and PayPal currency code (whole units only for HUF, JPY and TWD); revolut builds the general https://revolut.me/<revtag> link, which never carries an amount; other takes any https payment link (http and javascript: are refused). Returns the link, the button HTML for a web page and an email signature version (a table with inline styles), using your label and colours; colours below WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) are refused. type donate returns PayPal's own Donate button SDK code instead, using hosted_button_id for a business account or business (email or payer ID) for a personal one. Nothing is checked with PayPal or Revolut. The tool page also draws a QR code for the link. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/payment-link-button-generator/

amount.description: Optional amount for a PayPal.Me link, up to two decimal places

background.description: Button colour as a hex code

currency.description: Optional PayPal currency code added after the amount

donateId.description: For type donate: the hosted button ID (business) or the PayPal email address or payer ID (personal)

label.description: Button text. Defaults to Pay with PayPal, Pay with Revolut or Pay now

newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab

paypalMe.description: PayPal.Me name: letters and numbers, up to 20 characters. A pasted paypal.me link is fine

revtag.description: Revolut Revtag, with or without the @

textColour.description: Text colour as a hex code

url.description: For type other: the full https payment link

name: hopi_payment_link_button_generator

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)
